movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Gentle Vibe
abilities.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, have their Combat Stages reset, and are cured of any Volatile Status ailments.

abilities.name: Prime Fury
abilities.effect: The user becomes Enraged, and gains +1 Combat Stage in each of Attack and Special Attack.
